name: Deadeye
source:
Kooky scientist. Deadeye is constantly on the prowl for guinea pigs for her weapons experiments. She also has a penchant for very odd comestibles. Deadeye is continuously making upgrades for weapons, or coming up with new designs. She's one of the youngest, but also one of the brightest.

[from [url=http://starwish.auriplane.net/?Characters]official site[/url]]
